summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video ## Topology Process p01: Introduction and Use of Topology Tools in Marvelous Designer ### Creating a Smart Top Line To create a smart top line, select the Smart Top Tool and click on the tab in the 2D window to start. When the smart top line is completely closed, a split line will appear inside. ### Ensuring Correct Shapes It is essential to ensure that the shape is a completely closed triangle or quadrilateral to create a correct smart top. If you have five lines, although they are closed, you cannot create a split line; you need to divide it into a triangle and a quadrilateral. ### Modifying the Top You can create a new top from the top of a line. Before clicking on "Create," the top of each line can be reconnected to form a new top. You can modify the split number of lines in the tab window for each line. ### Finalizing the Smart Top Line When creating a smart top line, you can also modify the split. Click on "Create," and the top will form. Under the create tool, you can press `CTRL + Shift + Apply`. In the menu on the right, you can choose to reset all the webpages, and the dragon mode only retains the original version. ### Editing Points Based on the new version generated by the top, replace the original version with the current version generated by the top. When using the editor top, you can press `CTRL` and `SHIFT` to create a new page. After selecting the main point, you can merge the points in the right-click menu. ### Adjusting Points When I'm on the top, I'll go to the top of the block. This way, I can easily adjust the number of points in each place. At the beginning, keep the number of points as low as possible, as it’s easy to change the top grid after creation. ### Modifying the Smart Top Line After creating a smart top line, if you need to modify the points, you can directly select the line to modify. If you want to change the size, you can use the appropriate tools. If you want to change the thickness, you can do that by using the top mid. ### Completing the Top Face After clicking on the creation, the top face will be generated, but you may still need to manually modify some versions. For the collar and sleeve circles, I will use the Edit Top Tool to adjust the distribution of the top points, then combine the Edit Top and Create Top tools to create the circular face. ### Using the Edit Tool I am using the Edit Tool to create the circular face to make the border of the collar line after inserting the mile or zb. This makes it easier to achieve some special effects. If you find the distribution of points is not uniform, you can unify them after the top is completed and use a brush to smooth it out. ### Changing the Dragon Section Ensure the edges are even. The part of the dragon also needs to change from the current top to a circular one. The method used here is the same as the method used above. After deleting unnecessary structures, re-add the lines and points. ### Handling Open Lines You may notice an opening line at the back of the screen. If there is an opening line, it cannot be symmetrical. We need to cut it and sew it in the top. Notice that there are blue auxiliary top points on the board. ### Sewing Relationships When one side has a sewing relationship, the top point created on a piece of board will show the auxiliary top point on the corresponding board, allowing you to do the top so that the two top points of the two pieces of board can be matched. ### Dividing Sections The back of the board is also divided into pieces, called the top of creation. If the line cannot connect in the middle, we can divide it into several pieces to create, as long as the terms are the same, and then merge the points. ### Combining Points After creating the top surface, combine the points in the middle separately. Similarly, connect the loop of the front panel on the circular side of the collar and the part of the sleeve. ### Adjusting Sleeve and Collar Next, check the left and right sides to ensure they match specified dimensions. For the back part of the sleeve, connect the length to the operating line to match the length of the front part. ### Final Adjustments Adjust the top point to the support point and the bottom point to the support point. Start from the middle, ensuring the left and right sides are correctly divided. ### Conclusion After the top is completed, it should be aligned with the support point. Reduce the shape of the round plate for better fit and ensure that the points of the face are evenly distributed. ### UV Mapping Open three test windows and switch one of them to a UV window to see the UV of the entire costume. First, pour out the high-model costume that is well dressed, but choose a thin one when pouring out, which can be combined or disassembled as needed. ### Cloning and Replacing Versions When selecting the editor top tool, you have options for clone and replace. The clone refers to the original version, while the replacement refers to deleting the original version. Notice that whether you replace or clone, the UV position of the created version will change. ### Transmitting UV To transmit UV in Maya, ensure the position of the version in the 2D window does not change. Reset the position of the version in the 3D window. After that, you can transmit UV in Maya after flattening the grid. ### Final Steps Select all versions and reset the 2D position before pouring out. Once all versions are finished, click the continue button in the orientation menu. The 2D color in the 3D window will show the current version of the 2D option. ### Changing Colors You can now change the color of the image in 3D mode. In this case, we will use the slow motion of the UV ray in the 3D window to change the color. ```
